source_title: Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad urges not attending farmer suicides - The Hindu
source_excerpt: Buldhana Shiv Sena MLA Sanjay Gaikwad has said that people should not attend the funerals of farmers who die by suicide, urging crop growers to support their families and not abandon them. Amid rising farmer suicides in Maharashtra, a helpline run by ‘one of their own’ offers support Amid rising farmer suicides in Maharashtra, a helpline run by ‘one of their own’ offers support Pune-based Shivar helpline managed by young people from farming families offers both a listening ear and practical solutions Amid rising farmer suicides in Maharashtra, a helpline run by ‘one of their own’ offers support storyline “If nobody attended a farmer’s funeral and animals fed on the body, it might make others contemplating suicide realise the consequences and deter them from taking their own lives,” said the Buldhana MLA. Mr. Gaikwad made the comments at a press conference in Buldhana on Tuesday (October 27, 2026), when he was asked about a recent statement by a politician who apparently inadvertently used an expletive while talking about farmer suicides. Otherwise, let me know about your difficulties, and everyone will help you. But by taking your own life and leaving your children helpless, you are, in a way, punishing them,” he said. “You take the seven sacred rounds with your wife, vow to stand by her for seven lifetimes and promise to look after your children. Yet, if you end your life halfway through, what happens to those promises?” he asked. In 2024, he flaunted a tiger tooth worn around his neck and claimed that he had hunted the big cat in 1987. Last year, Mr. Gaikwad had slapped a canteen staff member allegedly for offering stale food at the MLA hostel in Mumbai.
